summary: Deterministic plan-local identity projections for Quick Dev router; PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; slices W0-W6; excludes logs/ and plan-state.v1.json/resume-state.v1.json; validates repository-relative non-parent, non-symlink paths confined to root; missing files recorded absent, files hashed SHA-256; loads implementation contract and requires matching plan_id plus slice list; flattens allowed_changes/planned_new_files, ignores wildcard entries, normalizes tools paths under execution plan; candidate manifest sorted/deduplicated canonically; dependencies include slice IDs and candidate hashes; identity predicate binds slice, contract, registry, candidate; authority and validator path sets are fixed; returns candidate, predicate, authority, validator, closure, validator-version, and validator-file hashes; full snapshot aggregates identities across all slices; ambiguity: filesystem state and contract/registry/authority/validator contents determine hashes.
